description: Locate stage of the pipeline: find the code and the requirements, then report them. The scripts derive the step from what they did and print the next call in a JOURNAL line (scripts/_journal.py).
steps: LOCATE: locate.py with the names and error text of the statement
UNDERSTAND: hints.py with the sentences or bullets of the statement that ask for something, then show.py [file, symbol] on the code to change
REPORT: the report the JOURNAL line gives, as the final message
